name: Pentobarbital Sodium

fda.text: Habit forming: Barbiturates may be habit forming. Tolerance, psychological and physical dependence may occur with continued use. (See " Drug Abuse and Dependence " and " Pharmacokinetics " sections). Patients who have psychological dependence on barbiturates may increase the dosage or decrease the dosage interval…

summary: Official warnings state that this drug can be habit-forming, and continued use may lead to tolerance as well as mental and physical dependence [3]. People who develop a mental dependence might take higher doses or take the medicine more frequently [3]. In addition, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated low risk scores of 47 for the liver and 21 for the heart [M].
